text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: .devcontainer/php-devcontainer:latest
      env:
        COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER: 1
        USER: contentful
        UID: 1000
        GID: 1000

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '8.1'
        extensions: pdo_mysql, intl, mbstring, xml, zip, gd, bcmath
    - name: Install Composer dependencies
      run: composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
    - name: Run tests
      run: composer test-quick-fail

  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '8.1'
        extensions: pdo_mysql, intl, mbstring, xml, zip, gd, bcmath
    - name: Initialize CodeQL
      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v2
      with:
        languages: 'php'
    - name: Autobuild
      uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
    - name: Upload results
      uses: github/codeql-action/upload-results@v2
```
